_comment: INTERIM (issue #34). macros[].lef is the 322-pin sram_256x32_array LEF at gf180-sram d0bacc0, used only to satisfy the required field (spec/macro-views-interim-decision.md): no pin-level claim comes from it, and its MACRO name differs from the instantiated sram_256x32. Macro pins come from rtl/sram_256x32_blackbox.v (unratified, gf180-sram#197). boot_rom is replaced by synth/boot_rom_const.v (constants). expected_latches=1 is the unmodified core's cve2_clock_gate latch, left unmapped by klt; see synth/README.md. Mapping corner is not a signoff corner.
